title: origin.md — YAML frontmatter
$comment: Frontmatter of origin.md. The origin is narrative only: why the work exists. Its frontmatter says whose document it is and when it was written; the title, parent and flags are thread.yml's. The body is the creator's words and is never capped or summarized. Its sections are '## Context & Motivation' (required and non-empty; the tool checks this at creation), then optionally '## Scope', '## Constraints' and '## Completion criteria'. The original body is never rewritten: `revise` appends dated sections under '## Revisions'.

created.description: When this origin was written: the thread's creation.
